payload.text:
Cohere advances sovereign AI capabilities with NVIDIA

Published: 2026-03-16
Canonical link: https://cohere.com/blog/cohere-sovereign-ai-nvidia

Today, Cohere announced it will accelerate the development of sovereign, secure, and efficient AI.
Together with NVIDIA, Cohere will build custom models optimized for secure enterprise deployments.
